trello.name: Configure Subscription Tiers in Stripe
trello.desc: Set up the three subscription tiers (Basic: $29/mo, Pro: $49/mo, Enterprise: $99/mo) in the Stripe dashboard. Ensure the pricing and feature sets for each tier are correctly defined to match the app's requirements.

trello.name: Implement Frontend Checkout with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements, ensuring the form matches the app's clean design. Include a prominent checkout button, clear feature comparison for tiers, and a tooltip/help icon explaining plan changes. Handle errors gracefully (e.g., invalid card details, insufficient funds).

trello.name: Update Pricing Page and User Dashboard Frontend
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Update the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers. Build the user dashboard frontend to display current plan details, billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel, access to invoices/payment history, and ability to update payment methods. Ensure real-time status reflection and user notifications for subscription changes or payment failures.

trello.name: Implement Backend Subscription API and Webhooks
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Integrate Stripe’s API to handle subscription creation, payment processing (success/failure), and webhook management. Specifically, implement handlers for 'invoice.payment_succeeded' (activate/continue subscription), 'invoice.payment_failed' (notify user, prompt payment update, send email), and 'customer.subscription.deleted' (cancel access, offer resubscription). Ensure system updates correctly upon these events.

trello.name: Develop and Execute Subscription Testing Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor (lead), Jordan (collaborator). Create a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up to billing to management). Simulate scenarios including payment failures, cancellations, and upgrades. Verify real-time frontend/backend synchronization and error handling. Deadline: Testing phase begins after initial integration (approx. 2 weeks from start), lasting 1 week.

trello.name: Draft User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan (Help section/FAQ), Taylor (API/Webhook docs). Create user-facing documentation including a help section or FAQ covering common subscription issues, plan management, invoice access, and troubleshooting. Taylor to document API endpoints and webhook event handlers for internal maintenance and troubleshooting.

trello.name: Schedule and Conduct Progress Review Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe integration, address blockers, and coordinate between frontend and backend teams.
